title: Sr Architect : Real Estate
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and creative Senior Architect to lead architectural design, planning, and execution for residential and commercial real estate projects. The candidate will be responsible for preparing architectural designs, reviewing drawings, coordinating with engineers and consultants, managing project timelines, and ensuring compliance with building regulations and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead architectural design and planning for residential, commercial, and mixed-use real estate projects.
* Prepare and review architectural layouts, floor plans, elevations, sections, and detailed working drawings.
* Develop innovative, functional, and cost-effective architectural concepts.
* Coordinate with structural engineers, civil engineers, MEP consultants, interior designers, and contractors.
* Supervise architectural design development from concept to project completion.
* Ensure compliance with applicable building codes, development control regulations, and local authority requirements.
* Prepare and review drawings for building permissions and statutory approvals.
* Conduct regular site visits to monitor architectural execution and construction quality.
* Review construction drawings, specifications, materials, and design modifications.
* Coordinate with project managers and site engineers to resolve technical and design-related issues.
* Monitor project schedules and ensure timely completion of architectural deliverables.
* Provide technical guidance and supervision to junior architects and draftsmen.
* Prepare project presentations, design proposals, and client presentations.
* Optimise space planning, material selection, and construction costs.
* Maintain architectural documentation, drawing revisions, and project records.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Architecture (B.Arch) from a recognised institution.
* Council of Architecture registration, where applicable.
* 5–10 years of experience in architectural design, preferably in real estate development.
* Strong proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, and architectural design software.
* Knowledge of 3D modelling, BIM, and architectural visualisation tools.
* Good understanding of residential and commercial building design.
* Knowledge of local building regulations, approvals, and construction practices.
* Strong technical drawing, detailing, and space-planning skills.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and project coordination abilities.
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and time-management skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience working with real estate developers, construction companies, or architectural consultancy firms.
* Experience in residential apartments, high-rise buildings, townships, villas, or commercial developments.
* Ability to independently manage architectural projects and coordinate multiple teams.
* Strong knowledge of construction materials, building systems, and design execution.
* Detail-oriented, creative, organised, and capable of meeting project deadlines.
* Experience in coordinating with local authorities for building approvals is preferred.

Key Skills

* Architectural Design & Planning
* AutoCAD and Revit
* Residential & Commercial Projects
* Building Planning & Approvals
* Architectural Working Drawings
* 3D Modelling & BIM
* Site Coordination & Supervision
* Project Management
* Building Regulations & Compliance
* Team Leadership
* Technical Problem-Solving

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹75,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Business Intelligence Architect
description:
Job Description – Business Intelligence (BI) Architect

Summary – The BI Architect will be responsible for designing reports and analytic solutions, gathering reporting requirements and documenting business processes as needed. The architect will develop enterprise grade dashboards and BI scorecards in Power BI, develop AI agents which work in tandem with BI reports. Also engages with other teams, departments and stakeholders to make sure all the reporting solution developments are fully understood and delivered to expectations.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

* Responsible for analysing software systems data and recommending Data Analytics solutions and strategy based on the needs of the organization.
* Expand or modify solutions to meet technical and business specifications; test, maintain, and monitor programs.
* Design and develop Scorecards and Dashboards using Power BI for various organizational metrics and KPIs.
* Develop overall Project technical design for report and dashboard development.
* Responsible for enterprise-grade analytics solutions for internal & external customer.
* Development of new reports and enhancement of existing reports using industry standards and best practices.
* Build Test cases and test plans for testing of reports to ensure data quality.
* Incorporate AI functionality into existing or new reports.
* Performance tuning of reports.
* Elicit business requirements from Subject Matter Experts using interviews, document analysis and requirements workshops.
* Use the gathered requirements to develop logic for reporting and analytics.
* Understand data standards & identify data abnormalities.
* Lead and provide technical guidance and mentorship to other team members.
* Perform statistical analysis, build predictive models, and formulate decision models that relate operational activities to results; to drive value stream enhancement and continuous improvement.
* Build end to end automated analytical solutions using Power BI, Power Apps and Microsoft Flow.
* Understand data standards and identify data abnormalities. Instill data quality in all solutions delivered.
* Maintain close alignment with all customers (internal, external, management and at the field level) and other data reporting teams to ensure requirements are being met.

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

  

* Bachelor degree or higher from a reputed university in engineering, IT, economics, math, statistics, science or other related fields in quantitative or analytical discipline.
* Minimum 7-10 years of experience in related data roles.

**SKILL:**

  

* Excellent skill level in SQL, PL/SQL.
* In-depth experience with Microsoft analytics Stack (Power BI, Power Query, Fabric, DAX, T-SQL, SSRS, SSAS)
  + Advanced knowledge Power BI.
  + Proficient in DAX, M language.
* Experience with Associated Development Tools - Visual Studios Data Tools, SQL Server Management Studio, SQL Server Data Tools, Microsoft TFS, GitHub.
* Working knowledge of Fabric Data Agent, Copilot, Microsoft Foundry.
* Knowledge of working with database client tools such as Toad.
* Knowledge of Data Mining, Clustering & Statistical Modelling (preferred).
* Experience with Azure Machine Learning (AML). Understanding of Azure and its data services.
* Knowledge of Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Azure SQL DW and Azure SQL.
* Experience with Microsoft Flow and Microsoft Power Apps preferred.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and O365.
* Superior documentation and organizational skills. Must be detail oriented.
* Excellent critical-thinking skills with the ability to research and analyze data retrieved from multiple sources
* Must possess and demonstrate excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communications skills.
* Must be an adaptable self-starter and work with minimal supervision. Must be able to handle multiple projects and organize time effectively.
* Must be willing to put in extra time and effort if need be. Go above and beyond the requirements of the job and strive to exceed expectations.

title: Delivery Manager - Engineering
description:
Responsibilities:

**About the Role**
------------------

This is an outstanding opportunity to advance engineering excellence, technology modernization, and pivotal initiatives across business-critical platforms.

---------------------------------------

* Support technical decision-making, architectural alignment, technical debt reduction, and platform simplification efforts.

------------------------------

* Drive adoption of data-driven decision making using engineering, delivery, quality, and operational benchmarks.
* Promote automation-first approaches to reduce manual effort, improve scalability, and accelerate time-to-market.

---------------------

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop engineering talent across multiple teams.
* Drive employee engagement, retention, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives.
* Build high-performing, inclusive teams passionate about collaboration, innovation, and customer outcomes.
* Assist with recruitment, onboarding, workforce planning, and talent acquisition efforts.

-----------------------------------

* Conduct regular mentoring and career development discussions with team members.
* Identify growth opportunities and build development plans aligned with organizational needs.
* Recognize and reward performance while encouraging a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

* Partner with Product Managers, Architects, Business Leaders, Operations, and Enterprise collaborators.
* Provide regular updates on delivery status, risks, dependencies, and strategic priorities.
* Influence decisions through data-driven insights, technical expertise, and strong business sense.
* Align engineering projects with business goals and customer results.

--------------------------

* 10-14 years of technology industry experience with progressive responsibilities in software engineering, technology delivery, or engineering management.
* 3+ years of people leadership experience leading engineering teams.

----------------------------

* Experience assisting with location strategy, workforce planning, and organizational growth initiatives.
* Experience presenting to senior leadership teams and portfolio governance forums.
* Experience managing large-scale transformation or organizational change programs.
* Solid grasp of Agile, Lean, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and Developer Experience (DX) principles.

Additional Information:

**What Makes You a Standout Candidate**
---------------------------------------

* Thinks like an Engineering Leader and Technology Strategist, not a traditional project manager.
* Uses AI, automation, and engineering insights to accelerate delivery and improve outcomes.
* Drives measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, reliability, and business value.
* Makes data-driven decisions using engineering metrics, delivery benchmarks, and business outcomes.
* Balances technology strategy, engineering excellence, people leadership, and business priorities.
* Builds a culture of innovation, continuous learning, accountability, and operational excellence.

title: Head of Global Banking Technology Engineering
description:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Head of Global Banking Technology Engineering

**The Opportunity**

The Head of Global Banking Technology Engineering is responsible for leading the engineering function across Global Banking Technology, providing strategic, operational and people leadership for a global organisation of approximately 300 engineers supporting Capital Markets & Advisory, CRM, Omnia and Infrastructure Finance & Sustainability.

The role is accountable for defining and executing the engineering strategy, ensuring the consistent adoption of engineering standards, modern software development practices, architecture principles and operational excellence across all technology domains. Working closely with Business, Product, Architecture and Technology leadership teams, the role ensures technology delivery aligns with business objectives while maintaining a strong focus on resilience, security, scalability and regulatory compliance.

The role will champion the responsible adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, automation and emerging engineering technologies to improve developer productivity, accelerate delivery, enhance operational effectiveness and support innovation across the Global Banking Technology organisation. The successful candidate will foster a culture of experimentation and continuous learning whilst ensuring AI capabilities are leveraged appropriately within governance, security, risk and regulatory frameworks.

As a senior technology leader, the role serves as a key member of the Global Banking Technology leadership team, driving engineering transformation, talent development, workforce strategy and delivery performance globally.

**What you’ll do**

Strategy and Leadership

* Define and run the engineering strategy for Global Banking Technology (Capital Markets and Advisory (CMA), CRM, Omnia and Marketing, Infrastructure Finance & Sustainability), in line with the bank's global technology roadmap and business priorities.
* Lead a matrix organization of engineering leads, architects, and engineers across multiple business domains.
* Anticipate how AI, automation and evolving technology landscape will reshape roles, skill mix, and team sizes and plan workforce transformation, cultural change and process changes required to adopt to changing time proactively.
* Represent CMA & FEM Technology in global leadership and engineering forums and build credibility with senior stakeholders.

Engineering Excellence and Delivery

* Own engineering delivery commitments across the portfolio: quality, cost efficiency, and time to market.
* Enable the Digital transformation of CMA Technology by delivering Digital capabilities to customers and delivering / maturing Agile Ways of Working across Technology and inform, assist the business to adopt these practices alongside technology.
* Drive adoption of modern engineering practices. Example, AI adoption, Resiliency, Technology risk management, CI/CD, DevSecOps, test automation, etc.
* Set and track engineering metrics, such as DORA metrics, defect leakage, availability, and productivity, and use them to drive continuous improvement.
* Lead modernization and enterprise estate simplification programmes: microservices, API-first architecture, and legacy decommissioning.
* Champion / lead responsible adoption of emerging technologies including AI coding assistants, agentic workflows etc. Put clear guardrails in place for security, data protection and model risk.
* Keep a forward-looking view of the technology landscape and make pragmatic build, buy or partner decisions.

Risk, Controls, and Governance

* Make sure all engineering work meets the organization’s technology risk, information security, and data privacy standards, and applicable regulations.
* Partner with Risk, Audit, Compliance, and CISO teams to remediate findings and keep a strong control environment.
* Recognize frontier AI models find and weaponize vulnerabilities faster than before. Identify and implement tooling / process so the organization can patch / mitigate at a comparable speed.
* Maintain a strong control environment with timely closure of audit and risk findings, clear risk ownerships, and transparent risk reporting to leadership.

Operation Resilience

* Own production platforms and operational resilience end to end for all services governed by Global Banking including incident management, disaster recovery, business continuity and ensuring organization can stay within tolerances.
* Ensure compliance with applicable global and regional regulatory frameworks.
* Embed site reliability engineering practices, strong observability and automated remediation to reduce manual toil and operation risk.
* Own regular scenario testing, disaster recovery exercises and failover drills and ensure lessons learned are implemented and read across the organization.

People and Culture

* Management responsibility for all Global Banking engineering staff globally.
* Attract, develop, and retain top engineering talent. Build strong leadership succession and technical career paths.
* Promote a culture of ownership, innovation, inclusion, and psychological safety.
* Invest in structured reskilling and upskilling in evolving technology and industry practices so that existing talent grows with the organization and industry.
* Build succession plans and a strong leadership bench for critical roles.

Leadership Competencies

* Strategic thinker who can turn global priorities into actionable local roadmaps.
* Knowledge of the financial services industry and global marketplace.
* Delivery of Complex Change: have consistently demonstrated the successful management and delivery of complex transformational change.
* Operational Resilience: Have shown strong ability to adapt and operate through disruptive change. Agile critical thinker able to lead through change at pace and with resilience.
* Executive presence and influence across geographies and cultures.
* Balances speed of innovation with control and risk discipline.
* Leader who builds people and scales organisations through others.
* Data-driven decision-maker with strong commercial skills.

**What you will need to succeed in the role:**

  

* A strategic leader with deep knowledge of the financial services technology, ideally experienced in Capital Markets, CRM, Global Banking or similar product lines.
* A broad and comprehensive understanding of the different systems, theories and practices relevant to technology
* Requires very strong abilities in critical thinking, creativity, and innovation in developing new concepts, theories, and products to address complex and strategic issues
* Delivery of Complex Change: Have consistently demonstrated the successful management and delivery of complex transformational change both regionally and globally
* Operational Resilience: Have shown strong ability to adapt and operate through disruptive change. Agile critical thinker able to lead through change at pace and with resilience.
* Degree level education – probably in Technology, Engineering or related STEM field.

**You’ll achieve more when you are at HSBC.**

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

title: Interior Architect
description:
**Job Description – Interior Architect**

**Department:** Architecture  
**Industry:** Real Estate  
**Experience:** 3–7 Years  
**Qualification:** B.Arch. / Degree or Diploma in Interior Design  
**Location:** Vashi  
**Reporting To:** Director

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Interior Architect to plan, design, and coordinate interior spaces for residential and commercial projects. The candidate will be responsible for developing interior design concepts, preparing detailed working drawings, coordinating with consultants and site teams, and ensuring that interior works are executed according to approved designs, specifications, quality standards, and project timelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Interior Design & Space Planning**

* Develop interior design concepts, layouts, and space-planning solutions.
* Prepare furniture layouts, reflected ceiling plans, flooring layouts, and interior elevations.
* Select suitable materials, finishes, colours, lighting, furniture, and fixtures.
* Prepare mood boards, material boards, and design presentations.
* Ensure functional, aesthetically pleasing, and practical interior spaces.

**2. Working Drawings & Technical Detailing**

* Prepare detailed interior working drawings using AutoCAD and other relevant software.
* Develop furniture, false ceiling, flooring, wall panelling, partition, and joinery details.
* Prepare electrical, lighting, and other interior coordination layouts.
* Prepare BOQs, material specifications, and finish schedules.
* Incorporate design revisions and ensure drawings are issued on time for execution.

**3. Consultant & Site Coordination**

* Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, contractors, and vendors.
* Coordinate with site engineers to resolve drawing discrepancies and execution-related issues.
* Conduct site visits to verify measurements and monitor progress.
* Ensure interior execution matches approved drawings and specifications.
* Provide technical clarifications and resolve site-related design issues.

**4. Material & Vendor Management**

* Assist in material selection, sampling, and approval processes.
* Coordinate with vendors and contractors for quotations, specifications, and material availability.
* Review material samples and shop drawings before execution.
* Support cost-effective material selection without compromising quality.

**5. Project Execution & Quality Control**

* Monitor interior work progress against project schedules.
* Ensure compliance with approved designs, quality standards, and safety requirements.
* Identify design or execution discrepancies and coordinate corrective actions.
* Maintain records of drawings, revisions, material approvals, and site observations.
* Coordinate snagging, finishing inspections, and handover activities.

**Required Skills**

* Proficiency in AutoCAD.
* Working knowledge of SketchUp, 3ds Max, Revit, Photoshop, or similar design software.
* Strong understanding of interior working drawings, detailing, and materials.
* Knowledge of furniture design, lighting, flooring, false ceilings, and finishes.
* Understanding of MEP coordination and site execution.
* Good communication, coordination, and project management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

Project Engineer

**Job Description Summary**

The MEP Site Engineer is responsible for the planning, execution, supervision, coordination, and quality control of Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) works at the project site. The role ensures that all MEP installations are carried out safely, efficiently, and in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, applicable codes, project schedules, and quality standards.

**Job Description**

### **About the Role:**

* Supervise and monitor day-to-day MEP installation activities, ensuring execution aligns with approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
* Coordinate mechanical works including HVAC systems, ventilation systems, chilled water piping, ducting, pumps, and related equipment installation and commissioning.
* Manage electrical installations including cable trays, conduits, cabling, panels, DBs, lighting, power distribution systems, and earthing systems.
* Oversee plumbing and fire-fighting systems including water supply, drainage, sewage, stormwater, hydrants, sprinklers, pumps, and associated equipment.
* Review MEP drawings, shop drawings, coordination drawings, and specifications to ensure compliance during site execution.
* Coordinate with contractors, consultants, subcontractors, architects, civil teams, and project stakeholders to resolve technical and coordination issues.
* Ensure quality control through inspections, material verification, testing, documentation, and compliance with project standards.
* Coordinate testing, commissioning, balancing, and handover activities for all MEP systems.
* Monitor project progress, manpower deployment, material utilization, and adherence to project schedules.
* Ensure compliance with HSE requirements and promote safe work practices across all MEP activities.

--------------------------

### **About You:**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

title: Solution Architect (Fluent)
description:
**Introduction:**  
Our goal at Pivotree is to help accelerate the future of frictionless commerce. We will help lead this change over the next decade because we believe a future where technology is embedded intimately into all aspects of our everyday lives can benefit everyone and will shape the interactions with the brands we love. We will help shape the future of frictionless commerce by working together with some of the best brands in the world and some of the best people in the industry to leverage converging technologies that will make it possible to accelerate frictionless commerce faster than ever.
  
  
Pivotree provides services focused on the design, implementation, management, and maintenance of complex ecommerce solutions for large enterprises. We provide the technical skills necessary to enable the effective use of technologies combined with the business context to leverage a solution to solve our clients' business challenges. We strive to fill the gaps in available technology with our own IP to reduce the barriers to adoption.
  
  
We enable inclusive, immersive and highly personalized experiences for our clients and their customers. We build our products with a view to productizing and scaling technology to lower the costs and reduce the risks of implementing and managing our integrated solutions. Each of our solutions starts with reliable and reputable e-commerce and MDM platforms, which run on enterprise grade infrastructure that are customized to meet a variety of client needs, situations, and budgets. Over the next 10 years we will add new categories and capabilities that will define frictionless commerce ecosystems.
  
  
This is a journey of technology acceleration combined with consumer readiness and adoption. We are looking for people capable of adapting relentlessly to the rapidly evolving world around us.
  
  
Role Overview
  
We are seeking an experienced Fluent Commerce OMS Technical Architect to lead the architecture, design,
  
implementation, and technical direction of enterprise-scale Order Management System (OMS) solutions using Fluent
  
Commerce.
  
The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Fluent Commerce, distributed OMS architecture, retail and
  
eCommerce workflows, system integrations, and cloud-native architectures, along with strong experience
  
translating complex business requirements into scalable and resilient technical solutions.
  
This role will work closely with client stakeholders, solution architects, developers, integration teams, and other
  
technical leaders to define architecture and deliver high-performance OMS solutions supporting complex omnichannel
  
business models.
  
  
Solution Architecture & Technical Design
  
l Own the end-to-end technical architecture for Fluent Commerce OMS implementations.
  
l Design scalable, API-driven, event-based, and distributed OMS architectures.
  
l Define solution architecture, technical blueprints, and integration patterns aligned with retail and eCommerce best
  
practices.
  
l Translate complex business and functional requirements into robust technical architecture and detailed solution
  
designs.
  
l Define architecture principles, technology standards, design patterns, and technical best practices.
  
l Review and validate solution designs, configurations, custom extensions, APIs, and integration approaches.
  
l Ensure solutions meet required standards for performance, security, scalability, availability, and reliability.
  
l Identify technical risks, architectural gaps, and dependencies and define appropriate mitigation strategies.
  
  
OMS & Fluent Commerce Architecture
  
l Provide technical leadership across the complete order lifecycle, including order capture, fulfillment, allocation,
  
orchestration, cancellations, returns, exchanges, refunds, and inventory management.
  
l Design and architect Distributed Order Management (DOM) solutions for complex omnichannel business models.
  
l Define inventory orchestration and fulfillment strategies across multiple locations and channels.
  
l Architect Fluent Commerce extensions and configurations based on business and technical requirements.
  
l Ensure the OMS architecture supports scalability, flexibility, maintainability, and high availability.
  
  
Integration Architecture
  
l Define and oversee integration architecture between Fluent Commerce OMS and enterprise systems, including:
  
**l Payment gateways:** PayPal, Adyen, and Stripe
  
**l ERP platforms:** SAP and Oracle
  
l Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
  
**l eCommerce platforms:** Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify, and Magento
  
l CRM and loyalty platforms
  
l Design and govern integrations using REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, asynchronous communication, and
  
event-driven architectures.
  
l Define reliable data flow and integration patterns between upstream and downstream systems.
  
l Review API contracts, integration specifications, data mappings, error handling, and retry mechanisms.
  
l Ensure integrations are scalable, resilient, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
  
  
Technical Governance & Quality
  
l Establish technical governance across OMS implementations.
  
l Conduct architecture reviews and design walkthroughs.
  
l Review technical deliverables and provide architectural guidance to development and integration teams.
  
l Define non-functional requirements and ensure they are incorporated into the solution design.
  
l Drive best practices around coding standards, integration design, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production
  
readiness.
  
l Identify opportunities to improve system performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  
Client & Stakeholder Engagement
  
l Lead technical and solution architecture workshops with client stakeholders.
  
l Collaborate with business, functional, technical, and integration teams to understand requirements and define
  
appropriate solutions.
  
l Present architecture decisions, technical approaches, and solution recommendations to technical and non-technical
  
stakeholders.
  
l Act as the primary technical point of contact for architecture-related discussions.
  
l Provide technical guidance during implementation, production support, incident triage, and root cause analysis.
  
l Support pre-sales activities including solutioning, technical estimations, architecture proposals, and RFP
  
responses.
  
  
Required Skills & Experience
  
l 10+ years of overall IT experience with enterprise systems and large-scale digital platforms.
  
l 4+ years of hands-on experience with Fluent Commerce OMS.
  
l Strong expertise in Order Management Systems and Distributed Order Management (DOM).
  
l Strong understanding of order lifecycle management, including order orchestration, fulfillment, returns and
  
exchanges, cancellations and refunds, and inventory orchestration.
  
l Strong experience designing REST APIs, JSON-based integrations, webhooks, and
  
asynchronous/event-driven architectures.
  
l Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and distributed systems.
  
l Experience designing scalable, resilient, and high-availability solutions.
  
l Excellent debugging, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.
  
l Strong understanding of Agile / Scrum delivery models.
  
l Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
l Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
Preferred / Nice to Have
  
l Experience working in omnichannel retail and large-scale eCommerce environments.
  
l Experience with cloud-native and microservices-based architectures.
  
l Experience integrating Fluent Commerce with SAP, Oracle, WMS, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify,
  
Magento, CRM, and payment platforms.
  
l Prior experience in client-facing consulting or solution architecture roles.
  
l Experience designing and supporting high-availability production systems.
  
l Experience participating in pre-sales, RFPs, solution proposals, and technical estimations.
  
l Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles and integration best practices.

title: QA Tech Lead
description:
**WHY XOGENE?**

At Xogene, we’re revolutionizing the future of clinical trial transparency through AI-powered solutions. Join our team of experts who are transforming how leading pharmaceutical and life sciences companies navigate regulatory compliance. If you're driven by solving complex problems in a professional environment focused on meaningful and rewarding work, we want to hear from you.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

Xogene combines regulatory expertise with advanced technology to automate complex processes in clinical trial transparency. Our software streamlines workflows through AI and agentic networking capabilities, improving data transformation and regulatory compliance for leading pharmaceutical and life sciences companies. We're committed to advancing technological solutions in clinical trial transparency.

As we continue to expand, we are seeking an experienced QA Tech Lead to drive our test automation initiatives and strengthen our testing strategy. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, the QA Tech Lead will own test automation strategy and execution.

This is a hands-on technical role: you will write and maintain automated tests while guiding the team's automation direction.

**KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead and mentor automation engineers, provide technical guidance to the wider testing team, and foster a culture of quality excellence and continuous improvement.
* Support skill development across the team, including cross-training manual testers in automation (e.g., Playwright Codegen, low-code contributions, and AI-assisted scripting with tools such as Claude) and ensuring automation engineers understand product domain and end-user workflows.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Development, Customer Success, Product Management, Design and Product Support across multiple time zones.
* Define the overall risk-based test strategy, focusing testing effort where regulatory and customer risk is highest, with clear criteria for which tests are automated, which remain manual, and what doesn't need a test at all. Own automation test plans and standards across all Xogene product releases.
* Create and maintain quality metrics, KPIs, and dashboards on testing progress and potential blockers, and provide regular updates to the Director of Engineering.
* Define test scope, objectives, success criteria, and time and resource estimates with stakeholders, and ensure comprehensive coverage through effective test case design and review.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate quality risks throughout each sprint cycle, including during pre-release dry runs.
* Architect, build, and maintain scalable automation testing frameworks, including our custom-built Playwright framework, enforcing code standards, and maximizing test reusability through the Page Object Model (POM).
* Develop and execute automated test scenarios, scripts, and procedures for system, integration, regression, and API testing, growing automated test coverage across all Xogene software products.
* Act as the technical point of contact and subject matter expert on the code and system architecture, diagnosing complex technical problems and designing solutions that reflect lessons learned.
* Identify manual test cases suitable for automation and work with the Test Lead to prioritize and transition them.
* Move automated suites from manual triggers to a tiered CI/CD strategy in GitHub Actions (Smoke, Sanity, and Nightly Regression) that serves as quality gates for developers, and maintain suite health, including resolving flaky tests and tracking automation coverage.
* Oversee the integration between Playwright and Zephyr Scale, reporting test results directly into Zephyr Scale through automated JUnit XML reporting pipelines and maintaining a single source of truth for QA metrics.
* Oversee test environments and test data management, ensuring realistic, compliant test data is available for both manual and automated testing.
* Perform manual testing where automation is impractical, defect triage and resolution, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), contributing automated regression coverage where practical.
* Contribute automation coverage and results to validation documentation, including the Test Plan, Test Summary Report, Traceability Matrix, and UAT Scripts.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Minimum 7 years of experience in software testing or QA engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical or automation lead role
* Hands-on experience testing large-scale enterprise SaaS web applications and complex software systems, including role-based access controls (RBAC), multi-tenant data isolation, and API integration layers
* Experience leading automation engineers and working closely with manual testers
* Solid understanding of manual testing, including test case design techniques (e.g., boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning), exploratory testing, and regression planning
* Ability to assess automation ROI and recommend the right balance of manual and automated testing effort based on risk, release cadence, and product maturity
* Expert-level proficiency in Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript or Python), including building frameworks from the ground up using design patterns such as the Page Object Model (POM), plus experience with other automation tools (e.g., Selenium, REST Assured)
* Strong hands-on programming skills (TypeScript, Python, JavaScript) and working knowledge of database technologies
* Proficiency in performance testing tools (JMeter, LoadRunner) and API testing frameworks
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and test integration strategies
* Expertise in the SDLC and test management tools (e.g., Jira, Zephyr Scale), including hands-on experience automating test execution uploads to Zephyr Scale via APIs
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical team members

**DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Ability to balance long-term automation architecture with immediate release needs

* Team leadership skills, including delegating and prioritizing work, giving constructive feedback, and supporting the growth of team members
* Commitment to staying current with industry trends and emerging testing technologies
* Experience working in fast-paced, innovative technology environments
* Experience in collaborative, agile teams that regularly deploy high-quality software to production
* Strong business acumen and understanding of how quality impacts customer success and business outcomes
* Experience testing in regulated environments (e.g., GxP, computer system validation, 21 CFR Part 11)
* Experience testing AI/LLM-powered features, including strategies for validating non-deterministic outputs
* Experience configuring AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude) to accelerate QA scripting workflows
* Background in lightweight DevOps tasks, such as Docker and managing staging/test environments

title: Application Development Manager - Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The Applications Development Senior Manager is a senior management level position responsible for accomplishing results through the management of a team or department in an effort to establish and implement new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to drive applications systems analysis and programming activities.
  
  
1. Strategic Engineering Leadership & Multi-Scrum Governance

* Lead, mentor, and manage multiple cross-functional Scrum teams (Software Engineers, Solution Architects, and QA/Automation Engineers) across globally distributed locations.

* Drive end-to-end delivery accountability across concurrent Books of Work (BOW), ensuring clear milestones, proactive dependency management, and on-time business outcomes.

* Champion engineering excellence, Agile maturity, and continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) best practices across all pods under management.

* Conduct personnel management responsibilities including technical coaching, talent acquisition, career development, performance evaluations, and team capacity planning.

**2. Hands-On Technical Authority & Solution Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Serve as the senior technical authority for enterprise-scale distributed systems, validating and steering high-level solution designs and low-level architectural patterns.

* Demonstrate active hands-on technical proficiency in **Java 21, Spring Boot 4.x, Cloud-Native Microservices**, and distributed persistence/messaging architectures.

* Establish and enforce rigorous coding standards, design patterns, automated test coverage gates, and continuous code quality reviews (SonarQube, Snyk).

* Drive architectural modernization initiatives, transitioning legacy frameworks into modular, scalable, event-driven, and containerized services (Docker, OpenShift/Kubernetes).

**3. AI & Agentic Automation Transformation**
---------------------------------------------

* Actively drive the adoption of **Generative AI, Agentic AI, and intelligent autonomous workflows** across the development and operational lifecycle.

* Identify repeat, recurring, and boilerplate engineering/operational tasks (e.g., automated code reviews, test generation, schema migrations, log analytics, incident triage) and architect multi-agent or prompt-engineered solutions to automate them.

* Foster a culture of AI-assisted engineering and experimentation within teams while strictly adhering to enterprise AI guardrails, security standards, and governance policies.

**4. Data Platform & Infrastructure Modernization**
---------------------------------------------------

* Oversee the architecture and optimization of high-throughput data and reporting pipelines leveraging relational engines (**Oracle 19c / OraaS**) and distributed document stores (**MongoDB 7.x/8.x / MaaS**).

* Design and govern high-volume event streaming and messaging fabrics utilizing **Apache Kafka and IBM MQ**.

* Ensure non-functional requirements (NFRs) such as high availability, fault tolerance, active-active failover, disaster recovery (RTO/RPO), and low-latency response times are rigorously met.
  

**Recommended Qualifications:**

* 10-15 years of relevant experience in the Financial Service industry
* Experience as Applications Development Manager
* Experience as senior level in an Applications Development role
* Stakeholder and people management experience
* Demonstrated leadership skills
* Proven project management skills
* Basic knowledge of industry practices and standards
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
  

**Education:**

title: Functional Engineer Reporting
description:
**About AkzoNobel**

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com

© 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.

**Job Purpose**
---------------

Data and Reporting team is focused on unlocking the value of data as it exists within AkzoNobel systems. We're an eclectic team of data-oriented doers who love to take on new challenges, are always learning, and looking for ways to improve decision-making.

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

Design, develop, test, and implement IT solutions and processes in IT systems like applications, platforms and networks through IT changes, projects in line with global Information Technology (IT) and security guidelines, to support company business requirements to create company value.

The **Functional** **Engineer in Application Delivery** is responsible for detailing design and hardwiring business requirements as per Architectural and Security guidelines. This is done through projects, changes and increasingly more through Agile Devops teams. This requires high quality Stories (change specifications) and projects changes which will allow Engineers and/or Developers to translate into code/configuration. The Functional Engineer sees to properly coordinate, review, approve and execute stories/project changes and has an active role monitoring status, in (unit)testing and change management once developed, including organizing sign-off after testing.

The Functional Engineer has an active role in the preparation and execution of the actual changes together with our partners and external consultants where applicable.

On request, a Functional Engineer can be asked to be involved in solving urgent high priority incidents and plays a role in process improvements alongside with business.

Depending on the domain and the progress of IT Fusion in our organization, the work is either done in agile teams under the leadership of a Scrum Master or in the case of a waterfall under the leadership of the Project Manager. Depending on the seniority of the Engineer, he/she will also assume these project management activities as a role or will take lead in delivery of end-to-end changes.

**Key Activities**
------------------

**Story specification**

Translate business requirements into clear detailed designs. Own and develop high quality Stories (change specifications) and project changes for Engineers and External Consultants to then translate into code or config and a proposal on a change implementation.

**Development & delivery**

Guide, coordinate and oversee the preparation and execution and implementation of the (project) changes and the development of the code/config of Stories. Ensure that all partners follow established standards (process- & documentation standards, coding and testing standards, naming conventions etc.). Review, Approve and control the implementation and/or embedding of new, enhancements and/or modifications of applications, systems and/or solutions.

This results in building sustainable and stable first-time right solutions in a very collaborate team spirit (also with external service providers) and in an engaging way with stakeholders and consumers of the solutions. Solutions are built according to the Architectural and Security principles and changes are timely & adequately prepared & documented and/or code works as intended.

**Testing**

Own testing of changes or stories, and/or actively oversee testing by business. Develop test scripts, examine test outcomes, sign off for unit testing and coordinate business sign off for Application Delivery related testing. Contribute to test planning and test management for a specific release.

Resulting in, changes and/or code are properly and timely tested.

**Incident management**

Perform functional or technical problem analysis in case of incidents or issues as needed depending on the severity of the problem. Perform root cause analysis, document these and share findings. Deploy (or oversee deployment) of updates and fixes. To ensure that issues, incidents and problems are swiftly and effectively resolved.

**Process management and improvement**

Monitor, guard, test and analyze that the use and security of applications and systems regarding the functional and performance aspects are in line with the agreed performance indicators, and if necessary, take measures. Actively contribute to process improvement: e.g. tool development, dashboard/insight development and visualization, script automation. Has a good view of the technical state of the application (technical debt) and regularly discuss and works seamlessly together with the (domain)Architect to develop plans to resolve the technical debt.

Resulting in, available and optimally performing applications and IT infrastructure for the business and, DevOps process, tooling and dashboards are continuously improving.

**Project support**

Support a project manager by taking ownership of specific project deliverables (specifications, config, testing, etc). Define, plan, manage and participate in assigned project deliverables from the own functional or technical domain, in accordance with the IT project manager and involved business project owners. Resulting in, efficient and effective realization of project deliverables.

**Experience**
--------------

**Business partnering**with all the stakeholders in the organization to determine opportunities / requirements for Data analytics solutions that can drive revenue growth, operational efficiencies, customer value etc.

**Project Management:** Should be able to independently manage several projects, track actions and reach out to stakeholders when needed.

**Solution design & development:**

Develop new solution using BI Tools (Power BI)

* Translate business logic to technical calculations that will help the technical team to build the metrics
* Fetch and embed data from SAP HANA, BW, Azure SQL, Excel, flat files, Sharepoint list etc.
* Perform data transformation, engineering, [joint, exclusion, enrichment, pivoting, etc.] using SQL, Databricks Pyspark(Good to have)
* Integrate & prepare multi sourced - complex data efficiently
* Automate tools/ data flow using best practices in collaboration with internal teams and Data Engineers.

**Improve and maintain existing solutions:**

* Suggest technical improvements / automation ideas for existing Analytics solutions
* Test and ensure compatibility of existing solutions upon new software version release
* Improve and safeguard dashboards performance (latency, downtime)
* Educate and train a variety of stakeholders about the dashboard technicalities & features
* Keep detailed technical documentation complete and up to date

**Academic and professional background:**

* Bachelors or master’s degree in analytics, Business, or finance from a premier institute
* Minimum 6+ years work experience in Data analytics & visualization roles in a global or multinational environment

**Skillset and professional experience:**

* Highly skilled in communication and collaboration, with experience in working with cross-functional teams and presenting data insights to executive stakeholders.
* Capable of working independently to identify business problems and opportunities that can be addressed through data analysis.
* Highly skilled in data analysis and modeling, with the ability to work with large datasets and complex data structures.
* Exceptional in creating visualizations in PowerBI (+DAX) that effectively communicate complex data insights to non-technical audience.
* Proficient in using SQL, and other data analysis tools.
* Good to have skills such as PySpark for Databricks, Python or R, with experience in data wrangling, data cleaning, and statistical analysis. Has a deep understanding of data modeling and can work with complex data structures.
* Experience in developing and implementing predictive models to forecast business outcomes and support decision-making.
* Excellent Presentation & PowerPoint skills

title: Staff Database Reliability Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**Staff Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Data Platform**

**OpenSearch Must-Have | Distributed Systems | Kafka | Redis | Capacity Engineering | Automation**

**Level**

Staff DBRE (Senior Individual Contributor / Technical Lead)

**Domain**

Distributed Data Platforms

**Primary Focus**

Cross-team architecture and systemic reliability for OpenSearch-centered data platforms, with Kafka, Redis, capacity engineering, and Python automation

**Work Expectations**

U.S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required

**1. Role Summary**
===================

We are seeking an experienced Staff DBRE with deep OpenSearch/Elasticsearch expertise and strong distributed-systems judgment. The role leads high-impact architecture, reliability, performance, scalability, capacity, and lifecycle improvements across major data-platform services, complemented by Kafka, Redis, Linux, observability, and Python automation.

The Staff DBRE solves ambiguous cross-team problems, establishes reusable platform patterns, mentors senior engineers, and influences multiple engineering groups. The scope extends beyond a single cluster or incident while remaining hands-on and evidence-driven.

**2. Level Scope and Leadership Expectations**
==============================================

Staff DBRE is a senior individual-contributor technical leadership role focused on solving ambiguous, high-impact reliability and architecture problems across platforms and teams. The role has broad influence within the data-platform domain, while enterprise-wide cross-domain strategy remains a Principal-level responsibility.

**Dimension**

**Expectation at This Level**

**Scope of Ownership**

Owns complex cross-team reliability, scalability, performance, capacity, architecture, and operational-maturity problems across major OpenSearch-centered platform services.

**Technical Depth**

Serves as a domain authority in OpenSearch and distributed-systems failure modes, with strong supporting depth in Kafka, Redis, JVM, Linux, storage, and networking.

**Engineering Leadership**

Defines platform-domain patterns, mentors Senior and Lead engineers, raises design-review and incident-analysis rigor, and influences adjacent teams.

**Automation Architecture**

Designs reusable Python automation, observability, validation, and lifecycle-management patterns rather than isolated scripts.

**Execution**

Drives ambiguous initiatives from problem framing through design, alignment, implementation guidance, and measurable outcomes.

**Organizational Influence**

Influences multiple engineering groups through data, production evidence, design standards, and technical judgment; does not unilaterally set enterprise strategy.

**3. Key Responsibilities**
===========================

**A. OpenSearch Platform Architecture**
---------------------------------------

* Design and improve large-scale OpenSearch/Elasticsearch topology, dedicated node roles, shard and index strategies, lifecycle management, workload distribution, and recovery patterns.
* Solve complex indexing, search, cluster-state, JVM/GC, storage, segment, mapping, allocation, and cross-cluster reliability problems.
* Establish domain-level resilience, snapshot, replication, upgrade, and capacity patterns appropriate to the actual scale of the environment.

**B. Kafka and Redis Reliability**
----------------------------------

* Guide Kafka topology, partitioning, replication, capacity, consumer reliability, and failure-mode remediation for critical services.
* Guide Redis Cluster and Sentinel architecture, memory and eviction behavior, persistence tradeoffs, failover, re-sharding, and client reliability.

**C. Automation, Observability, and Capacity Engineering**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Architect reusable Python tooling and safe remediation frameworks for provisioning, validation, maintenance, scaling, and incident prevention.
* Define domain-level observability, SLIs/SLOs, capacity models, lifecycle forecasts, and actionable risk thresholds.
* Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and operator patterns where they improve repeatability and supportability.

**D. Technical Strategy and Cross-Team Leadership**
---------------------------------------------------

* Lead architecture and production-readiness reviews for the data-platform domain.
* Evaluate emerging technologies through workload-relevant benchmarks, failure testing, operability reviews, and total-cost considerations.
* Lead complex technical investigations and systemic corrective actions; mentor engineers and improve engineering practices across teams.

**4. Required Qualifications and Experience**
=============================================

* 8+ years of DBRE, SRE, database, or distributed data-platform engineering experience with Staff, Lead, or comparable technical leadership scope.
* Deep hands-on mastery of OpenSearch and/or Elasticsearch internals, operations, performance, lifecycle management, recovery, and architecture.
* Strong production experience with Kafka and/or Redis, with the ability to reason across distributed data-platform failure modes.
* Strong systems expertise across JVM, Linux, CPU, memory, storage I/O, networking, and capacity behavior.
* Strong Python software-engineering capability for reusable production automation and tooling.
* Demonstrated success solving ambiguous cross-team technical problems and influencing architecture through evidence and judgment.
* Strong incident leadership, written communication, mentoring, and design-review skills.

**5. Preferred Qualifications**
===============================

* Experience with both Kafka and Redis at meaningful production scale.
* Kubernetes operators, Terraform, Ansible, GitOps, and cloud-managed data services.
* Experience evaluating ClickHouse, Pinot, vector databases, or stream-processing technologies.
* Experience with chaos testing, production-readiness reviews, and cost-aware capacity engineering.

**6. Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months**
=================================================

* Establish measurable reliability, capacity, lifecycle, and operational-maturity baselines for critical data-platform services and lead material improvements.
* Deliver reusable automation and observability patterns that reduce systemic toil and improve safe execution across teams.
* Publish and drive adoption of domain-level architecture, production-readiness, capacity, and resilience standards.
* Resolve one or more high-impact systemic risks and develop a prioritized multi-quarter improvement roadmap for the data-platform domain.

**7. What This Role Does Not Include**
======================================

* This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned; leadership is exercised through technical influence and mentorship.
* This is not a coordination-only role; the Staff DBRE must remain hands-on and capable of deep technical investigation.
* This role does not replace ownership held by application, SRE, infrastructure, network, storage, or cloud teams.
* This is not a ticket-queue role limited to incident response and routine operations; systemic improvement is expected.
* This role does not unilaterally define enterprise-wide cross-domain architecture or approval policy; that scope belongs to Principal-level and executive governance.

**8. Work Expectations and Location**
=====================================

This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

The team is organised into an AI Strategy function and three regional pillars: EMEA, US & Canada, and Coffee & Special Projects.

This role sits in the AI Strategy function and reports to the Tax Technology lead. You will set the technical and AI direction the three regional pillars build around, and partner across Tax, Tax Tech, Data Operations, Accounting, Product, and Engineering, as well as InfoSec, Internal Audit, and Compliance.

DoorDash is looking for a senior-level AI and data expert to lead how the Tax department operates through automation, Generative AI, and intelligent data tooling. title: Principal Architect | Strategic Enterprise Architecture
description:
**Company Description**

**About NIQ:** NIQ is a leading global consumer intelligence company, helping clients understand what is happening, why it is happening, and what they should do next. Our data, technology, AI, and analytics capabilities power decision-making for some of the world’s most important consumer, retail, and technology businesses.

AI is central to NIQ’s next stage of growth. We are building trusted, scalable, and high-impact AI capabilities that transform how insights are created, delivered, and adopted across the business. This role will help shape the platforms, operating model, and leadership system needed to make that ambition real.

 **Job Description**

Our NielsenIQ Technology teams are building and evolving Connect, a unified, global, open data ecosystem powered by AI, cloud and on-premises technologies. Clients around the world rely on NielsenIQ data and insights to innovate and grow. As a Principal Architect within the Enterprise Architecture team, you will define architecture for key components and capabilities across NIQ platforms, ensuring alignment with business strategy, product objectives, technology standards, and the long-term platform vision. You will partner with architecture peers, Product and Operations leaders, engineering leaders, and development teams to take solutions from initial requirements through design, delivery, and production operation. A key focus of this role is shaping the responsible adoption of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and agentic AI across the enterprise. The successful candidate will combine broad enterprise architecture experience with practical knowledge of AI-enabled systems and will grow into an end-to-end platform architect as their knowledge of NIQ's platforms expands.

**Role Mandate:** Act as the strategic Enterprise Architecture partner and single point of architecture accountability for an assigned NIQ product portfolio. The role connects business and product strategy to target-state architecture, capability ownership, technology roadmaps, governed standards, and delivery feedback. It is intentionally strategic while remaining close enough to Product, Engineering, Solution Architecture, and Architecture Practice teams to ensure that direction is actionable and produces measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities

* Own and maintain the portfolio target-state architecture and rolling three-year technology roadmap, aligned with business priorities, product strategy, engineering plans, and enterprise transformation goals.
* Serve as the named strategic architecture partner and single point of EA accountability for the assigned portfolio, building trusted working relationships with Product, Engineering, Operations, Data Science, Security, and business leadership.
* Create and maintain business-capability, domain, application, data, and platform maps that expose ownership, dependencies, duplication, maturity gaps, lifecycle risk, and opportunities for simplification or growth.
* Translate strategic priorities into clear architecture outcomes, transition states, investment options, sequencing recommendations, and measurable decision criteria.
* Guide platform-placement and build-versus-buy decisions, balancing enterprise reuse and standards with appropriate portfolio autonomy, speed, cost, resilience, and client commitments.
* Define and contribute reusable reference architectures, patterns, guardrails, and decision trees, including patterns for AI, Generative AI, agentic AI, data, integration, cloud, security, and observability.
* Drive adoption of approved architecture standards and bring standards, reference architectures, major exceptions, and cross-functional decisions through the lightweight EA governance process for ratification.
* Own visibility of portfolio architecture risks, strategic exceptions, technical debt, capability gaps, and cross portfolio dependencies; ensure actions, owners, and escalation paths are clear.
* Partner with the Solution Architecture pillar to triage architecturally significant demand, shape initiatives early, and ensure delivery-level learning feeds back into portfolio strategy, standards, and roadmaps.
* Assess emerging technologies and market shifts, especially AI and agentic commerce, and convert relevant signals into adoption guidance, controlled experiments, investment recommendations, and roadmap implications.
* Enable self-service architecture by creating high-quality, reusable content for NIQ architecture knowledge repositories and supporting AI-enabled access to standards, patterns, decisions, and portfolio views.
* Establish and run an effective operating cadence, including strategic portfolio reviews, intake alignment with Solution Architecture, reference artifact alignment with the Architecture Practice, and architect-only sessions to drive capability and domain consistency.
* Define outcome-oriented measures for the portfolio, such as roadmap adoption, reuse, simplification, risk reduction, decision cycle time, standards adoption, and value realized from technology investments.
* Support M&A due diligence and integration planning by assessing capability fit, architecture compatibility, technology risk, redundancy, security considerations, and potential integration paths.
* Mentor architects and engineering leaders, communicate complex decisions clearly, and influence across organizational boundaries without relying on direct authority.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, solution architecture, platform architecture, or enterprise architecture, including significant experience with enterprise-scale products and data platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to define target-state architectures and multi-year technology roadmaps, and to connect them to business capabilities, product objectives, investment decisions, and executable transition plans.
* Experience operating as a strategic advisor to senior Product, Engineering, Technology, Operations, or business leaders, with evidence of influencing decisions across multiple organizations and geographies.
* Strong knowledge of capability-based planning, domain and platform mapping, application rationalization, technology lifecycle management, technical debt, and architecture risk management.
* Experience creating and driving adoption of enterprise standards, reference architectures, reusable patterns, architecture decision records, and governance processes that are pragmatic and lightweight.
* Strong understanding of modern cloud, data, integration, API, security, resilience, observability, and distributed system architecture, preferably in Microsoft Azure and hybrid environments.
* Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, and agentic AI architectures, including model and tool integration, retrieval augmented generation, orchestration, context and memory, evaluation, guardrails, observability, human oversight, and Responsible AI controls.
* Ability to assess emerging technologies and develop clear build-versus-buy, adoption, migration, and total-cost of-ownership recommendations.
* Experience partnering with Solution Architecture and delivery teams on architecturally significant initiatives while preserving a strategic, portfolio-wide perspective.
* Excellent written, visual, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to express complex architecture choices as concise options, trade-offs, decisions, roadmaps, and executive-level narratives.
* Proven facilitation, stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to establish accountability and progress in a matrixed organization.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience in data, analytics, measurement, consumer intelligence, retail, media, or other information intensive product environments.
* Knowledge of ArchiMate, capability-based planning methods, and enterprise architecture repositories such as ADOIT.
* Experience with product operating models, agile delivery, portfolio planning, FinOps, and outcome-based technology investment governance.
* Experience supporting technology due diligence, post-merger integration, platform consolidation, or large-scale modernization and simplification programs.
* Hands-on engineering or architecture experience with APIs, Python, databases, data pipelines, cloud-native platforms, MLOps or LLMOps, or enterprise AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI.
* Thinks in business capabilities, portfolios, platforms, and multi-year outcomes rather than isolated projects.

**Successful Profile:**

* Balances enterprise consistency with purposeful autonomy and avoids governance for its own sake.
* Creates clarity from complexity, makes decision ownership explicit, and converts strategy into reusable architecture assets.
* Builds trust through early engagement, pragmatic recommendations, transparent trade-offs, and reliable follow-through.
* Uses delivery feedback to continuously improve target states, standards, patterns, and investment guidance.

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)
  
  
Bain’s [2] AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
The Impact You’ll Have
  
  
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
* Embedding generation and optimization
* Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
* Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
* Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
* Hallucination rate and factual consistency
* Relevance and precision/recall
* Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
* Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

Working Model & Travel
  

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Architect


In this role you will be:

* Understand business outcomes work with business stakeholders to define outcomes that are traceable to solution designs.
* End\-to\-end solution design for large, multi\-market frontline channel products/features, ensuring they meet customer and business outcomes reporting to the senior architect.

* Communicate decisions and trade\-offs clearly to business and engineering stakeholders, highlighting risks, dependencies and options.Drive governance and risk management—produce architecture deliverables, ensure reviews happen at the right time, and manage deviations from standards with the right approvals.


To be successful in the role

* Architecture experience, ideally in financial services, delivering complex platforms end\-to\-end.

* Be strong in CRM architecture and extensibility (configuration/customisation, platform patterns, and integration to surrounding systems). Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform is an advantage.

* Show practical AI solution design experience, including agentic/human\-in\-the\-loop workflows and safe integration patterns.
* Be fluent in API and event\-driven design, including REST, asynchronous messaging, and integration standards.
* Apply strong security architecture judgement, covering identity, access control, encryption/data handling and cyber risk.
* Operate confidently in agile, global delivery, guiding engineers with clear direction while staying pragmatic and delivery\-focused.Navigate governance, risk and ambiguity well—document decisions, manage stakeholders, escalate early, and stay composed under pressure.


You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
